footer.tagline: A creative duo making campaigns people actually talk about.

home.heroDescription: Copy and art duo. Campaigns people talk about, made on small budgets.

about.title: Broke on budget.
about.description: Creative Broke Boys is a two-person creative team. We work on campaigns, brand identities and digital pieces, and we handle the whole thing ourselves: strategy, copy, art and production.

steps.listenBody: We start with your business problem, not with a moodboard.
steps.insightBody: The small human truth that makes an idea land.
steps.makeBody: Copy and art built together from day one, not handed across a desk.
steps.launchBody: We adapt the idea to every channel it needs to live on.

roles.copyBio: Finds the angle, writes the line, defends it in the meeting.
roles.artBio: Turns the line into something you can't scroll past.

contact.title: Let's make
contact.description: Tell us about the brand, the problem and the deadline. The rest we can figure out together.

form.name: Name
form.sent: Your email app should open with the message ready. If it doesn't, write to us at the address on the right.

faq.a1: Most projects kick off within one to two weeks of our first call.
faq.q2: How long does a project take?
faq.a2: It depends on the scope. Most run between four and twelve weeks.
faq.q3: Do you work with clients abroad?
faq.a3: Yes. We work remotely and in both English and Spanish.
